name: Asthma
overview: Asthma is a chronic airway disease with reversible bronchospasm, inflammation, and hyper-responsiveness to triggers. It affects millions in India, often worsened by air pollution and allergens. Good control allows normal activity with a personalised action plan.
symptoms: Cough, often worse at night or early morning
Symptoms triggered by dust, pollen, cold air, or exercise
riskFactors: Family history of asthma or allergies
treatment: Leukotriene modifiers or LABA add-ons as needed
Trigger avoidance and inhaler technique education
prevention: Avoid known triggers and passive smoke
Annual influenza vaccination (recommended for asthma patients)
Use controller inhaler regularly as prescribed
Written asthma action plan for exacerbations
complications: Reduced lung growth in untreated childhood asthma
emergencySigns: Peak flow below 50% of personal best

faq.question: Can I rely on this Asthma information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

faq.question: What should I do if Asthma symptoms worsen suddenly?
faq.answer: Seek urgent medical care, especially if severe pain, breathing difficulty, confusion, or high fever develops.
